cards.card_text: And the chief baker was hanged, just like the young Hebrew said.
cards.verse_text: And it happened to us just as he had interpreted: I was restored to my position, and the other man was hanged.”
cards.snippet: …interpreted: I was restored to my position, and the other man was hanged.”

cards.card_text: The bones of the seven who were hanged are left where they are.
cards.verse_text: So David had the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan brought from there, and they also gathered the bones of those who had been hanged.
cards.snippet: …there, and they also gathered the bones of those who had been hanged.

cards.card_text: They're hanged on the gallows They're sent into exile They're thrown into prison
cards.verse_text: After the report had been investigated and verified, both officials were hanged on the gallows.
cards.snippet: After the report had been investigated and verified, both officials were hanged on the gallows.

cards.card_text: The plan is to ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai hanged on it.
cards.verse_text: His wife Zeresh and all his friends told him, “Have them build a gallows fifty cubits high, and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai hanged on it.
cards.snippet: …cubits high, and ask the king in the morning to have Mordecai hanged on it.

cards.card_text: He points out he's already given Esther Haman's estate, and Haman was hanged on the gallows because he attacked the Jews.
cards.verse_text: So King Xerxes said to Esther the Queen and Mordecai the Jew, “Behold, I have given Haman’s estate to Esther, and he was hanged on the gallows because he attacked the Jews.
cards.snippet: …Jew, “Behold, I have given Haman’s estate to Esther, and he was hanged on the gallows because he attacked the Jews.

cards.card_text: Then comes her second request: that the bodies of Haman's ten sons be hanged on the gallows.
cards.verse_text: Esther replied, “If it pleases the king, may the Jews in Susa also have tomorrow to carry out today’s edict, and may the bodies of Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”
cards.snippet: …out today’s edict, and may the bodies of Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”

cards.card_text: An edict goes out in Susa, and Haman's ten sons are hanged.
cards.verse_text: An edict was issued in Susa, and they hanged the ten sons of Haman.
cards.snippet: An edict was issued in Susa, and they hanged the ten sons of Haman.

cards.card_text: The king also commands that Haman and his sons be hanged on the gallows.
cards.verse_text: But when it came before the king, he commanded by letter that the wicked scheme which Haman had devised against the Jews should come back upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
cards.snippet: …upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
